key_concepts: Biological evolution is change over time through genetic inheritance
Life on Earth shares a common ancestor
Fossil records provide evidence for evolution and the history of life
Most fossils are found in sedimentary rock
Comparative anatomy provides evidence for evolution
Homologous structures share common origin and structure but may have different functions
Analogous structures have similar functions but do not show common evolutionary origin
Vestigial structures are reduced or functionless remnants that indicate evolutionary histo
Similar DNA sequences are strong evidence of common ancestry
Heritable gene mutations can affect the evolution of species
Natural selection favors organisms with adaptive traits for survival and reproduction
Modern horse fossils show changes in skull and limb structures over time
